verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। बृहस्पतेश्च संवादं शक्रस्य च युधिष्ठिर॥१॥
verses.english: Sthanu said Know, O lord, that my prayer to you is in behalf of the created beings of the universe! These beings have been created by you. Do not be angry with them, O Grandfather.

verses.sanskrit: शक्र उवाच। किं स्विदेकपदं ब्रह्मन्पुरुषः सम्यगाचरन्। प्रमाणं सर्वभूतानां यशश्चैवाप्नुयान्महत्॥२॥
verses.english: By the fire born of your anger, illustrious one, all the created beings are being burnt. Seeing them placed in such a condition, I am filled with compassion. Do not be angry with them, O maker of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरुवाच। सान्त्वमेकपदं शक्र पुरुषः सम्यगाचरन्। प्रमाणं सर्वभूतानां यशश्चैवाप्नुयान्महत्॥३॥
verses.english: The lord of all created beings said, I am not angry, nor is it my desire that all the create beings should perish. It is only for lightening the lord of the Earth that destruction is desirable.

verses.sanskrit: एतदेकपदं शक्र सर्वलोकसुखावहम्। आचरन्सर्वभूतेषु प्रियो भवति सर्वदा॥४॥
verses.english: The godess Earth, suffering from the load of creatures, requested me, O Mahadeva, for destroying them, especially as she appeared to sink under their load into the water.

verses.sanskrit: यो हि नाभाषते किंचित्सर्वदा भ्रुकुटीमुखः। द्वेष्यो भवति भूतानां स सान्त्वमिह नाचरन्॥५॥
verses.english: When after exercising my intelligence even for a long time I could not find out the means by which to bring about the destruction of this overgrown population, it was then that I was possessed by ire.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु सर्वमभिप्रेक्ष्य पूर्वमेवाभिभाषते। स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषी च तस्य लोकः प्रसीदति॥६॥
verses.english: Do not give way to anger, O lord of the celestials, about the destruction of living creatures! Be-pleased! Let not these mobile and immobile beings be destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: दानमेव हि सर्वत्र सान्त्वेनानभिजल्पितम्। न प्रीणयति भूतानि निर्व्यञ्जनमिवाशनम्॥७॥
verses.english: All tanks, all sorts of grass and herbs, all immobile beings, and all the four divisions of mobile creatures, are being consumed. The whole universe is about to be shorn of beings. Be pleased, O divine Lord! O you of pious soul this is the boon that I seek at your hands.

verses.sanskrit: आदानादपि भूतानां मधुरामीरयन् गिरम्। सर्वलोकमिमं शक्र सान्त्वेन कुरुते वशे॥८॥
verses.english: If destroyed, these creatures would not return. Therefore, let this energy of yours be neutralised by your own energy.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सान्त्वं प्रयोक्तव्यं दण्डमाधित्सतोऽपि हि। फलं च जनयत्येवं न चास्योद्विजते जनः॥९॥
verses.english: One who is capable to win over all men by conciliation should be consulted, O monarch, by the king, who wishes to rule according to the dictates of the science of punishment.

verses.sanskrit: सुकृतस्य हि सान्त्वस्य श्लक्ष्णस्य मधुरस्य च। सम्यगासेव्यमानस्य तुल्यं जातु न विद्यते॥१०॥
verses.english: All this inobile and immobile creatures, O lord of the universe, originated from you. Pacifying you, O god of gods, I beg of you that living creatures may repeatedly come back into the world, undergoing repeated deaths!

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              इत्युक्तः कृतवान्सर्वं यथा शक्रः पुरोधसा। तथा त्वमपि कौन्तेय सम्यगेतत्समाचर॥११॥
verses.english: Narada continued Hearing these words of Sthanu, the divine Brahma of controlled speech and mind himself suppressed that energy of his within his own heart.
